Thanks for the note, Sam. Short answers first then a proposed operational path:

- Sponsor-split: yes, we can support a sponsor-funded credit pool. The pool lives at the account level and we can invoice the sponsor monthly or up front. We do require an explicit order form that ties the deal to the cohort (deal id and list of participant account emails helps us map consumption).

- Private/Dedicated usage: by default, our promotional credits apply to Hosted and Dedicated (reserved capacity) offerings. Private (customer-managed VPC/on-prem) is normally excluded because it involves a separate deployment contract and license. However, we can make an exception for cohort pilots under the following conditions: a) sponsor signs order form, b) customer signs DPA, c) we include a limited service addendum for access/support, and d) credits allocated subject to a 90-day usage window.

Operational proposal:
1) We create a single sponsor invoice for the credit pool (monthly preferred).
2) Launchpad provides a roster mapping (name + email + startup name). We provision internal allocation IDs and limit per-startup caps.
3) For startups requiring Private, we trigger a manual exception flow: legal signs the DPA + addendum (1-2 business days turnaround typical), and we carve out a sub-allocation for Private usage (we recommend capping Private consumption to 25% of the sponsor pool to protect capacity).

Ive looped in Ben (sales) and Marissa (program ops) to confirm pricing and the allocation spreadsheet. Attaching a draft schedule for the sponsor pool.

If that sounds ok, Ben will reply with the numbers and invoicing options and well route the DPA to your finance/legal contacts.

Thanks,

Thanks Irene — adding concrete numbers so Launchpad can review:

Proposal (sponsor-funded pool):
- Total sponsor pool: 50,000 credits (equivalent compute units).
- Per-startup soft cap: 2,500 credits (20 startups covered).
- Allocation: 30,000 credits usable on Hosted/Dedicated; 20,000 credits reserved for Private exceptions.
- Private exception uplift: Private usage is billed as a redemption of credits but we apply a 30% resource uplift (to account for dedicated infra/support).
- Credit expiry: 90 days from activation.

Invoicing options:
A) Sponsor prepay (one invoice) for full pool up front.
B) Sponsor monthly invoicing (we invoice for consumed credits each month, subject to a minimum monthly draw).

We can map consumption via a shared roster (email -> allocation id). For Private exceptions well require a signed DPA and the addendum; legal will need the Launchpad cohort roster as part of the DPA exhibit.
